title: Toddler Left Alone In Car While Mom Goes Shoplifting
description:
On March 30th, 2024. People noticed a child was left unattended in a boiling hot car for an abnormal amount of time. It turned out that a mom took her 10yo daughter inside the store to shoplift and claimed she went inside to pee.
